title: orthosiphon tomentosus var. glabratus
intro: Orthosiphon tomentosus var. glabratus, commonly known as Uva-Ursi or Bearberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include acting as a diuretic, helping to relieve urinary tract infections and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Orthosiphon tomentosus var. glabratus include antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its ability to provide relief from various health issues.
